Circuit simulation
------------------
Cadence Spectre 15.1.0.627 (CPU transient), nutascii output.
Device models: PTM 45 nm BSIM4 predictive compact models
  (nmos_vtl_bsim4.inc / pmos_vtl_bsim4.inc under models/ptm45/).
  These are public predictive models and are NOT redistributed here;
  place them under models/ptm45/ relative to the netlists before running.

Spectre invocation template
  spectre <netlist>.scs +escchars +log <name>.log -format nutascii -raw <name>_ascii

Python
------
Python 3.11 (see requirements.txt). CPU is sufficient; the network study
runs in minutes on CPU.
